answer: Like bees guarding nectar, an agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable bond before it may attest work, slashed on proven fraud. One bad actor can afford a single bond, but a sybil farm must fund every alias, so cost scales with the attack. Honest attestations ripple trust outward, each verified job raising the attestor's standing, while a lagoon of unvouched newcomers stays shallow: new identities take only small jobs until their history deepens, so fake identities starve before they can drain the pool.
